value.rationale: A unique core is an intrinsic feature of a compact flat Möbius band with totally geodesic boundary. The probability a random globally minimizing geodesic intersects it is a natural incidence observable, and its exact strict range (0,1/2) makes a single scalar a complete similarity invariant. The w=1 threshold is a genuine third-derivative phase boundary. This is a continuum-wide geometric classification and inverse fact, not a table lookup or arbitrary parameter example.
